_comment: resources/minecraft-code/.../monster/skeleton/SkeletonModel.java createDefaultSkeletonMesh() — head/body inherited unchanged from HumanoidModel.createMesh (see humanoid.json), but arms/legs are real vanilla skeleton proportions: 2x12x2 (not 4x12x4), and the leg pivot is +-2.0 (not +-1.9 like humanoid.json's legs). textureHeight 32 matches createBodyLayer()'s LayerDefinition.create(mesh, 64, 32) — this is the legacy 64x32 skin format.
